question: List the names of all students.
schema: Table students: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, age INTEGER, department_id INTEGER
sql: SELECT s.name FROM students AS s;

question: Show each student name with the title of the course they enrolled in.
schema:
Table students: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT
Table enrollments: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER, course_id INTEGER
Table courses: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT
trc: { s.name, c.title | students(s) AND enrollments(e) AND courses(c) AND e.student_id = s.id AND e.course_id = c.id }
sql: SELECT s.name, c.title FROM students AS s JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.id;

question: How many students are in each department?
schema:
Table students: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, department_id INTEGER
Table departments: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT
trc: { d.name, COUNT(s.id) | departments(d) AND students(s) AND s.department_id = d.id }
sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(s.id) AS student_count FROM departments AS d JOIN students AS s ON s.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name;

question: List the students who are enrolled in a course worth more than 3 credits.
schema:
Table students: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT
Table enrollments: student_id INTEGER, course_id INTEGER
Table courses: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, credits INTEGER
trc: { s.name | students(s) AND EXISTS e (enrollments(e) AND e.student_id = s.id AND EXISTS c (courses(c) AND c.id = e.course_id AND c.credits > 3)) }
sql: SELECT s.name FROM students AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollments AS e WHERE e.student_id = s.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM courses AS c WHERE c.id = e.course_id AND c.credits > 3));

question: Which instructor teaches the Databases course?
schema:
Table instructors: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT
Table course_offerings: course_id INTEGER, instructor_id INTEGER
Table courses: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT
trc: { i.name | instructors(i) AND EXISTS o (course_offerings(o) AND o.instructor_id = i.id AND EXISTS c (courses(c) AND c.id = o.course_id AND c.title = 'Databases')) }
sql: SELECT i.name FROM instructors AS i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_offerings AS o WHERE o.instructor_id = i.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM courses AS c WHERE c.id = o.course_id AND c.title = 'Databases'));
